approved_message: Please report to Assembly Hall reception for incident SAF-2026-044. Bring the first-aid kit and follow the emergency response protocol. Emergency services are being contacted separately.
authorization: Send once to one currently certified responder whose exact DingTalk identity is verified.
escalation_boundary: Do not ask an expired or unverified person to take charge. Contact emergency services through the established human emergency channel; DingTalk does not provide that capability.
